description: Standard time-value-of-money annuity formula, solved in either direction. Mode "payout-from-principal" takes a lump sum and computes the fixed periodic payout a given number of periods at a given rate would produce; mode "principal-from-payout" takes a desired periodic payout and computes the lump sum required to fund it. Structure "ordinary" assumes payments at the end of each period, "due" at the start (worth one extra period of growth each). Pure closed-form formulas, no live rate data.

annualRatePercent.description: Annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 5 (cannot be negative)

periodicPayout.description: Required for mode "principal-from-payout": the desired payout per period

principal.description: Required for mode "payout-from-principal": the lump sum to annuitize

structure.description: Whether payments land at the end ("ordinary") or start ("due") of each period

name: calculate_annuity_payout
